title: Canonical dualizing tensor cocycle and its etale source consequence
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum and the specified counit-normalized maps of [def-pur-conventions], [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization] and [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition]. For every composable smooth triple of separated finite-type morphisms of pure nonnegative relative dimensions between finite-type k-schemes, sigma satisfies the threefold cocycle, with the canonical associator, pullback-composition and tensor-pullback comparisons inserted. For the same triple with etale first arrow f, postcomposition of sigma_(fg),h with the associativity congruence and E_f,gh equals the tensor of E_f,g with the pullback compositor, followed by inverse tensor-pullback comparison and f^*sigma_g,h. No base-change, general open-locality, or finite-expression assertion is part of this lemma.

source.place: Step 1; the refined proof of lem-pur-dualizing-sigma-cocycle-locality

proof.text:
First fix the comparison maps, including their domains. For every smooth pair, [lem-pur-composition-tensor-mate] gives that the composite is smooth of the summed pure dimension, that the required exceptional images and dualizing objects lie in $D^b_{ctf}$, and that $c$, $\theta$ and $\sigma$ on these inputs are isomorphisms. It also supplies etale-origin witnesses for the compact-support adjunctions. The site/counit transport in [lem-pur-finite-site-counit-projection-transport] identifies the specified finite exceptional compositor with the conjugate of the compact-support compositor used there, so these are the maps of the statement. Write $G_a=Ra^!$. Associativity of compact supports [thm-sf-comp-composition], conjugation [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], and pasting along composite adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] give
$$C:=(G_u c_{w,v,\Lambda})c_{wv,u,\Lambda}=c_{v,u,\omega_w}c_{w,vu,\Lambda}:\omega_{wvu}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_uG_v\omega_w.$$
Indeed these two conjugates are the two sides of compact-support associativity, so their equality follows by the conjugation bijection and the pasting law. We henceforth insert the tensor, symmetry and threefold pullback comparisons of [lem-pur-smooth-exceptional-tensor-pasting]; its final clause ensures that these reassociations are the same in either order.

proof.text:
Put $K=\omega_w$ in $(*)$ of [lem-pur-composition-tensor-mate], with $f=u$, $g=v$. This is an allowed finite-Tor input by the same lemma applied to a pair ending in $w$. Let
$$D=\omega_u\otimes Lu^*\omega_v\otimes Lu^*Lv^*\omega_w,$$
and let $s:D\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu^*(Lv^*\omega_w\otimes\omega_v)\otimes\omega_u$ be the canonical permutation and reassociation. After postcomposition with $C$ from Step 1, the left side of the desired cocycle becomes
$$c_{v,u,K}\theta_{vu,K}\mathrm{sym}(\sigma_{u,v}\otimes1)=\theta_{u,G_vK}(Lu^*\theta_{v,K}\otimes1)s,$$
exactly $(*)$ after moving $L(vu)^*K$ to the first factor. For the right side, use naturality of the specified tensor transpose [def-pur-co-smoothness] with the arrow $c_{w,v,\Lambda}:\omega_{wv}\to G_vK$. Its postcomposition with $C$ is
$$G_u(c_{w,v,\Lambda})\theta_{u,\omega_{wv}}\mathrm{sym}(1\otimes Lu^*\sigma_{v,w})
=\theta_{u,G_vK}(Lu^*(c_{w,v,\Lambda}\sigma_{v,w})\otimes1)\mathrm{sym}
=\theta_{u,G_vK}(Lu^*\theta_{v,K}\otimes1)s.$$
Here $c_{w,v,\Lambda}\sigma_{v,w}=\theta_{v,K}\mathrm{sym}$ is the defining formula for $\sigma$. Both arrows from $D$ therefore agree after the isomorphism $C$; cancellation proves the cocycle.

source.place: Step 1, coherence of composition and tensor reassociation, and etale localization of the remaining constituents (old item steps 6-7); agent-written refinement of the blueprint argument

proof.text:
Suppose now that $u$ is etale. From clause (3) of [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization],
$$E_{u,h}\sigma_{u,h}=\eta_u\otimes1$$
with the unitor inserted, for $h=v,wv$. Postcompose the cocycle of Step 2 with $E_{u,wv}$ and use these two equalities. The resulting equality is
$$E_{u,wv}\sigma_{vu,w}(\sigma_{u,v}\otimes1)=Lu^*\sigma_{v,w}((E_{u,v}\sigma_{u,v})\otimes1).$$
Cancel the isomorphism $\sigma_{u,v}\otimes1$. This gives precisely the asserted etale source identity, with its domain $\omega_{vu}\otimes L(vu)^*\omega_w$ and codomain $Lu^*\omega_{wv}$. The only removal of a dualizing factor here is by the prescribed $\eta_u$.
